body_html:
#edu407 First stop thinking you are writing for a grade. The writing you do in college is a genre you will probably never write again. Just get to know it.

It seems you are on you way by understanding some of the key differences in college level writing.

We need organization. Use headers. Make sure paragraphs revolve around single ideas.

Define key words, better yet discuss how the field defines them...even better then offer your own alternative.

Focus on parallelism. if you have different sections make sure they are organized the same way. You do this down to the paragraph level.Yet you need sentence variety....

Keeping things exactly the same but totally different is the key to great writing.
